item.title: Review: Evening All Afternoon at Donmar Warehouse
item.description: ‘A reflective, compassionate exploration of a modern family life’ As winter loosens its grip and blue skies return to the capital, the arrival of a new play at the Donmar Warehouse feels especially restorative. Anna Ziegler, who enjoyed notable West End success with her Photograph 51, returns with Evening All Afternoon for its world premiere
